api.hubStateSrc:
function () {
          return {
            version: HUB_VERSION,
            inHub: hub.inHub,
            location: hub.location,
            mode: getHubMode(),
            transitionLock: hub.transitionLock,
            modalOpen: hub.modalOpen,
            activeStationId: hub.activeStationId,
            selectedCircle: hub.selectedCircle,
            unlockedCircles: hub.save.unlockedCircles.slice(),
            defeatedResidents: hub.save.defeatedResidents.slice(),
            completedInvasions: hub.save.completedInvasions.slice(),
            visitPeaceTimer: +hub.visitPeaceTimer.toFixed(2),
            invasionWarning: hub.invasion.warningActive,
            invasionActive: hub.invasion.active,
            extractionAvailable: canReturnToHubNow(),
            extractionBeacon: hub.extractionBeacon ? Object.assign({}, hub.extractionBeacon) : null,
            storageAvailable: hub.storageAvailable,
            lastCorruptionRecovered: hub.lastCorruptionRecovered,
            saveWrites: hub.saveWrites,
            transitionsCompleted: hub.transitionsCompleted,
            transitionErrors: hub.transitionErrors,
            officialUntainted: Array.isArray(Qe) && Qe.length === 0
          };
        }
